name: Épure Botanique
title: Épure Botanique — Atelier de Soins · Botanical Hair & Skincare
description: Épure Botanique crafts clean, high-performance botanical hair and skin care ritual essentials. Cold-pressed active botanicals, plant ceramides, clean, and cruelty-free.

faq.q: Are your hair and skin care products suitable for sensitive skin and scalps?
faq.a: Yes. Every formulation is dermatologist-tested, hypoallergenic, free from synthetic sulfates, parabens, silicones, and artificial fragrances, and balanced to natural physiological pH.

faq.q: How should I introduce the serums and oils into my routine?
faq.a: Start by applying 2–3 drops onto cleansed, slightly damp skin or clean damp hair ends. Use once daily for the first week, then adjust according to your scalp and skin moisture needs.

faq.q: Are all products 100% vegan and cruelty-free?
faq.a: Absolutely. We are certified cruelty-free by Leaping Bunny and use strictly plant-derived active oils, herbal extracts, and bio-fermented hyaluronic acids.

faq.q: What is your return and guarantee policy?
faq.a: We want you to love your ritual. We offer a 30-day gentle guarantee on all care treatments for a full exchange or refund, plus refill pouches for all amber glass bottles.
